title: Chapter 1: I Became The Strongest In One Day
description: Nor Verner accidentally kills Dark Heavens Overlord Rodon and activates the System.
excerpt: A level 6 throws a rock and kills a level 890 overlord.

title: Chapter 2: Home
description: After awakening, Nor returns home and discovers the changes in his body.

title: Chapter 3: Ravenport
description: Nor reaches Ravenport and discovers he can see other people's status windows.
excerpt: After forty minutes of walking, Nor began to notice the signs that he was getting closer to the city.

title: Chapter 4: Greymoor Guild
description: Nor meets Edora and Orlan at the entrance of Greymoor Guild.
excerpt: A strange collision at the guild entrance introduces Nor to two powerful figures.

title: Chapter 5: Greedy Master
description: Nor meets the eccentric Master Chuck Loyn and hires him as a teacher.
excerpt: A legendary Master agrees to teach Nor... after spotting two gold coins.
